status: what has survived testing, not what is deployed and not a profitability claim; no transaction cost is in any of these numbers
requirements: a lift over a baseline knowable at the cutoff
survival of a date-blocked bootstrap, because rows are not independent
the same sign in walk-forward folds trained from scratch
a realised forward return in the direction claimed

confidenceBands.name: MEDIUM
confidenceBands.why: clears a blocked-bootstrap z of 5 and holds its sign in every walk-forward fold

confidenceBands.name: LOW
confidenceBands.why: clears a blocked-bootstrap z of 2 but is thinner, or does not hold every fold

highIsUnreachableFromBacktest: HIGH is reserved for a lane with matured prospective outcomes; a holdout is still a backtest and this project does not print HIGH on one

lanes.why: clears a blocked-bootstrap z of 5 and holds its sign in every walk-forward fold

directional precision clears the base rate in every fold, and the realised 5-session return of the rows called DOWN was positive in four years of five (+1.38% 2023, +1.07% 2024, +1.70% 2025). The price rose after the model said fall; precision over a three-class label is not the price moving
